lab_questions.title: Subscription Proration & Mid-Cycle Plan Downgrade
lab_questions.description: A B2B SaaS recurring billing engine handles mid-cycle plan changes, tier downgrades, and subscription renewals.
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Task 1: Mid-Cycle Proration Calculation
tasks.description: Calculates unused days credit from the current tier, applies it towards the new plan, charges the difference, or stores excess as customer credit balance.

tasks.title: Task 2: Scheduled Period-End vs. Immediate Downgrade
tasks.description: Supports timing = 'PERIOD_END' (keeping current plan active until period boundary) vs timing = 'IMMEDIATE'. Enforces tier hierarchy validation (400 Bad Request if invalid).
